genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. USDP is issued by Paxos Trust Company, N.A. Current issuer disclosures report its December 12, 2025 conversion, and the OCC active national-trust-bank list confirms charter 25379. The current USDP product page expressly states readiness for forthcoming GENIUS requirements, supporting issuer-announced-intent on the federal-qualified-nonbank pathway. The December 2025 charter decision is not a separate GENIUS PPSI approval; no public USDP-specific GENIUS approval or officially acknowledged GENIUS application was located. The August 7, 2025 NYDFS consent order against the same pre-conversion legal entity imposed a penalty and compliance remediation for historical deficiencies, including the Binance relationship. OCC charter condition 8 carries that remediation into 2026-2027. warning-or-notice records this public issuer action; it does not assert a GENIUS violation or a prohibition on USDP issuance. Treasury identifies January 18, 2027 as the expected Act effective date and July 18, 2028 for the later DASP issuer-status restriction. Public reserve and redemption disclosures and monthly independent examination reports remain available.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The October 7, 2026 scoped review confirmed the issuer national trust charter and current USDP GENIUS readiness statements, but found no separate public GENIUS PPSI approval or official acknowledgment of a GENIUS application for USDP or its issuer. Ordinary charter approval and GENIUS rulemaking do not establish that status. Public issuer enforcement history was found and is recorded separately. This is a dated search result; confidential supervisory filings and determinations cannot be excluded.
